linkedin:
Anthropic has filed to list on Nasdaq as ANT. Its S-1 shows $16.3 billion of revenue in the first half of 2026, up from about $1.2 billion a year earlier. Of the $80.7 billion net loss, $72.4 billion is a non-cash charge; the operating loss was $693 million.

Control stays inside: one Class F share gives the co-founders 50.1% of the vote, and a trust elects most of the board. For developers, stricter account enforcement means gray-market access can vanish. https://badeifer.github.io/news/anthropic-s1-ipo-filing/
